company.name: Epic Games
company.shortDescription: Epic Games is an interactive entertainment company that develops games and offers its game engine technology to other developers.
company.description: Epic Games is an American video game and software company that creates games and offers its game engine technology to other developers. It specializes in developing games and engine technology and operates a game store that empowers others to make quality games and 3D content, thereby providing game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and virtual reality devices.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $17,860,000,000 to $22,500,000,000, a 1.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 50 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
